title: Freight Container
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY.TROOP SUPPORT CONSTRUCTION & EQUIPMENT.DLA TROOP SUPPORT
detail_text: This is a Pre-Solicitation Notice of the Government’s intent to issue a solicitation for the following requirement: National Stock Number: 8150-01-533-8673 Quantity: 170 Item: Freight Container Location: CONUS This is not a Request for Quote and only the Government notice of intent in the near future. When the solicitation is published on DIBBS, the Government’s requirement will be fully outlined in the solicitation. All responsible sources may submit a bid, proposal or quotation which shall be considered by the agency – REFERENCE – FAR 5.207 (c) (16).
